'''Terran''' is a map based on a layout design from a previous map called tekno.bsp, except this one is slightly larger with more areas to move around at, especially for the player out of control. The map has rather standardized item sets. Design is connected to the map '''Zerg''', in similar texturing, a unified in a darker styled with blue and silver details, intended to relate to the aesthetic of the Starcraft universe.

Locs made by {{player|Flintheart|flag=se}}
